What I deliver

Work that moves straight from drawing to bill of quantities to site, with quantities you can trust and details a crew can build.

MEP quantity surveying

Detailed take-offs for plumbing, mechanical, and electrical works, organized by system and ready for pricing.

Cost estimation

Material and labor estimates built from measured quantities, so budgets reflect what will actually be installed.

2D CAD drafting

Clean plans, riser diagrams, isometrics, and details drawn to be read and built in the field.

3D visualization

Models that show routing, clearances, and coordination with the structure before work begins.

How a take-off comes together

A repeatable sequence that keeps quantities traceable from drawing to estimate.

  1. Review plansStudy drawings and specifications, and flag conflicts early.
  2. MeasureTake off pipes, fittings, fixtures, and equipment by system.
  3. PriceApply material and labor rates to the measured quantities.
  4. DeliverHand over drawings, models, and a clear cost breakdown.
